display_title: If the Lady in the Corner Gets Caught
description:
Born to a modest fortune in a romance fantasy, she lived the life of a shut-in, eating, playing, and sleeping to her heart's content.

"The rumour that you're a sickly, meek young lady is certainly wrong."

When she is forcibly dragged to an imperial ball her secret gets revealed by Armin Gray, a Duke who is as arrogant as he is handsome.

"My secret... Will you keep it?"  

"Why should I? I've never had so much fun in my life."

Armin Gray starts to creep into her life. Then the duke and duchess keep trying to get me involved with their son. Soon enough, her life as a shy socialite begins to unravel!
